dimensions.P: mean pixel frequency inside the own mask, per patch
dimensions.S: distance from the mask centroid to its brightest pixel (px)

event.source: Autobahn GmbH via havel_werder_analysis/havel_werder_asset_hierarchy.md (Step-0 A0 document) and havel_werder_asset.json

export_columns.coherence_gamma2: the export's own coherence column — provenance, never the mask rule's gamma2
export_columns.coherence_masked_pixels: the export's own definition (the brightest decile of the window), not a count of the echo mask

mask_rule.text: intensity >= 0.30 * max(intensity) AND intensity >= 5.0 * np.median(intensity); A = count(mask); gamma2 = |sum z|^2 / (A * sum |z|^2), clamped to [0, 1]
mask_rule.window_note: one 80x80 complex window per acquisition at the site point; the export committed no latitude/longitude, no segment_index and no burst id (the anchor is the OSM bridge outline, see werder_havel_aoi.py), and a window carries no pixel-spacing spec

notes: one row per (track, date) of the committed measurement extract; the mask dimensions are recomputed from the committed mask cache
P is computed within a patch (role): the reference chains measure different objects and are never folded into the bridge's frequency map
echo = 1 wherever A >= 2; a chip without an echo keeps its geometry dimensions but carries no behaviour channel

persistence.note: P is computed within a role (a patch), never across the export's three objects
